text: An equivalence f: A → B in HoTT is a function with:
choices: a left and right inverse (but they may differ)
a quasi-inverse — but two quasi-inverses of the same function may not be equal
a contractible type of quasi-inverses (half-adjoint or bi-invertible equivalence)
explanation: isEquiv(f) is defined to be a PROPOSITION (contractible choice of inverse data). Using just 'has a quasi-inverse' gives a non-propositional definition. The half-adjoint definition is standard.
